newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Pikko rises 15.6 pct after debut.
newsitem.headline: Bank Pikko rises 15.6 pct after debut.

text.p: Shares in Indonesia's Bank Pikko rose 15.6 percent after its stockmarket debut on Wednesday, topping the bourse's active list in morning trading, brokers said.
Bank Pikko quickly rose to 1,000 rupiah after the opening before it eased back to 925 rupiah at 0400 GMT, against its offer price of 800 rupiah, on a volume of 7.2 million shares.
Brokers said the upward trend appeared to be limited because of perceptions that its price was already high.
"I think this prevailing price is good, it is not disappointing," a local broker said.

The bank listed 128 million of its shares after offering 28 million shares to the public late last month. The remaining 100 million shares belong to two privately-owned companies and two individuals linked to the founding of the bank.
Bank Pikko in the first six months of 1996 recorded a net profit of 2.34 billion rupiah.

It said 75 percent of the float proceeds, estimated at 22.4 billion rupiah, will be used to increase the bank's loan portfolio, while 20 percent will finance branch expansion and the remaining five percent will be used for internal technology and information development.
The initial public offering was underwriten by local firms PT Trimegah Securindolestari and PT Usaha Bersama Sekuritas. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
